manifest.name: dsh-session-inbox
manifest.description: A file-backed inbox for DeepSeek Harness sessions: any process drops a JSONL line into ~/.dsh/inbox/<sessionId>.jsonl and the target session picks it up when idle, as a normal user turn.

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch layer for dsh-session-inbox. Referenced by package.json's
# `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` reconciles this package into the
# profile's bundle list and this row mounts the plugin.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-session-inbox
      name: dsh-session-inbox

readme.text:
中文 | [English](README.en.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-inbox)
[](https://github.com/SleepNap/dsh-session-inbox/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 会话用的**收件箱**。

任何进程——另一个 DSH 会话、Claude Code、Codex、脚本、CI，或者你自己——往
`~/.dsh/inbox/<sessionId>.jsonl` 追加一行 JSON 即可。目标会话活着且空闲时，插件会把这条消息
取走，作为一条普通的用户消息交给该会话。

没有 socket、没有守护进程、没有握手、没有 MCP 服务。一条消息就是文件里的一行，所以目标被关闭、
被杀、被重启，消息都还在。

各家 agent 内部早就能互相发消息：Codex 有 `queue`，Claude Code 有会话间消息，DSH 有 session
bridge。但**跨产品**没有共享的会话注册表、没有共享路由、也没有共享的 agent 循环，所以没有任何
东西能唤醒属于别人的会话。

文件系统是每个进程都能碰的唯一交集，于是交接发生在这里：**投递落到磁盘，执行留给会话的所有者。**

**桌面应用（最省事）**：设置 → 插件 → **添加插件** → 输入包名 `dsh-session-inbox` → 安装 → 重启。

**命令行**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-inbox
```

**国内网络**：在「添加插件」里把源切成**中国大陆镜像源**（`registry.npmmirror.com`）。新版本同步到镜像有延迟，急的话可以去 npmmirror 的包页面手动同步一次。

**其他方式**（不经过 npm）：

```sh

readme.section: GitHub 直装（本包没有构建脚本，因此不需要 allowBuilds 授权）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:SleepNap/dsh-session-inbox

dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-session-inbox
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-session-inbox-0.1.0.tgz
```

装完重启宿主。插件挂载时会打印 `[dsh-session-inbox] watching …`。

装完重启宿主。插件挂载时会打印 `[dsh-session-inbox] watching …`。
```sh

readme.section: 投递一条消息（DSH 是否在运行都可以）
readme.text: dsh-peer-inbox send --to session-<uuid> --text "..." --from claude-code

dsh-peer-inbox pending            # 各收件箱待投递条数
dsh-peer-inbox list               # 有收件箱的会话 id
```

接收方看到的是：

```
[inbox] 来自 claude-code 的消息：
...
```

一行一个 JSON 对象，行末必须有换行。`to` 必须等于文件名去掉 `.jsonl`。

```json
{"id":"<uuid>","ts":"<ISO-8601>","from":"<谁>","to":"<sessionId>","text":"<正文>"}
```

| 情况 | 表现 |
| --- | --- |
| 目标活着且空闲 | 注入，游标前进 |
| 目标正在跑 | 留在文件里，不打断 |
| 目标不存在 | 一直保留，等该会话出现 |
| 坏行 | 永久跳过，避免堵住队列 |
| 多条消息 | 一次一轮，串行消费 |

游标在 `~/.dsh/inbox/.state/`，**只前进不后退**，所以第二个宿主不会把游标写回旧值、导致重放。

- **推不进不属于你的会话。** 插件只服务挂载它的那个 DSH 宿主内的会话，够不到别的产品的会话。
- **`from` 是自报字段。** 任何能写收件箱的进程都能冒充任意发件人，**绝不能拿它做授权判断**。
- **投递不等于确认。** 入队成功不代表模型读到了；需要确认就约定「带 id、回显 id」。

`engines.dsh` 是纯下限（`>=0.1.7-0`），不设上界。插件除了宿主注入的 `agents` 之外不 import 任何
DSH 包，所以不会钉死 harness 版本。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-inbox)
[](https://github.com/SleepNap/dsh-session-inbox/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

A **mailbox for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sessions**.

Any process — another DSH session, Claude Code, Codex, a script, a CI job, or you — can drop one
JSON line into `~/.dsh/inbox/<sessionId>.jsonl`. When that session is live and idle, this plugin
picks the message up and hands it to the agent as a normal user turn.

No socket, no daemon, no handshake, no MCP server. A message is a line in a file, so it survives
the target being closed, killed, or restarted.

Agents can already message their own kind: Codex has `queue`, Claude Code has session messaging,
DSH has its session bridge. Between *different* products there is no shared registry, no shared
router and no shared agent loop, so nothing can wake a session that belongs to someone else.

The file system is the one thing every process can touch, so it is where the hand-off happens:
delivery goes to disk, execution stays with whoever owns the session.

**Desktop app (easiest)**: Settings → Plugins → **Add plugin** → enter `dsh-session-inbox` → install → restart.

**Command line**:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-session-inbox
```

**Behind the GFW**: switch the source in *Add plugin* to the **China mirror** (`registry.npmmirror.com`). Fresh versions take a while to reach the mirror; you can trigger a sync from the package page on npmmirror.

**Without npm**:

```sh

readme.section: straight from git (no build script, so no allowBuilds permission needed)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:SleepNap/dsh-session-inbox

dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-session-inbox
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-session-inbox-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart the host after installing. The plugin logs `[dsh-session-inbox] watching …` at mount.
```sh

readme.section: queue a message (works whether or not DSH is running)
readme.text: dsh-peer-inbox send --to session-<uuid> --text "..." --from claude-code

dsh-peer-inbox pending            # pending counts for every inbox
dsh-peer-inbox list               # session ids that have an inbox
```

The receiving session sees:

```
[inbox] 来自 claude-code 的消息：
...
```

One JSON object per line, newline-terminated. `to` must equal the file name without `.jsonl`.

```json
{"id":"<uuid>","ts":"<ISO-8601>","from":"<who>","to":"<sessionId>","text":"<body>"}
```

| Situation | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| target live and idle | message is injected, cursor advances |
| target running | message stays in the file, no interruption |
| target not live | message stays in the file until that session exists |
| malformed line | skipped permanently so it cannot block the queue |
| multiple messages | injected one turn at a time |

The cursor lives in `~/.dsh/inbox/.state/` and only ever moves forward, so a second host cannot
rewind it and replay messages.

- **No push into a session you do not own.** This plugin only serves sessions inside the DSH host
  that mounted it. It cannot reach another product's session.
- **`from` is self-declared.** Any process that can write the inbox can claim any sender. Never use
  it for authorization.
- **Delivery is not acknowledgement.** A queued message proves nothing about whether the model read
  it; agree on an id-and-echo convention if you need confirmation.

`engines.dsh` is a floor (`>=0.1.7-0`) with no upper bound. The plugin imports nothing from the DSH
packages beyond what the host injects (`agents`), so it does not pin a harness version.
